card.name: Words completing a stock phrase
card.fires_on: Words in general web prose that sit just before the end of a familiar phrase or clause, such as 'main areas of', 'birthright', 'middle name', 'battle cry'. It also fires on commas and 'to' after 'object of this work'.

modes.label: Inside set phrases
modes.description: A word in the middle or at the end of a common fixed expression.
modes.example: Fighting pesticide drift has been one of PAN’s main<< areas>> of focus for the last several years.

modes.label: Clause links
modes.description: A comma or 'to' in an old-style sentence about the aim of a work.
modes.example: Now it is one great object of this work<<,>> to shew the importance and advantage of

modes.label: Compound noun endings
modes.description: The last word of a two-part noun like middle name or battle cry.
modes.example: This might well be the battle<< cry>> of the Nigerian news media

card.plain: It lights up on words in the middle of familiar stock phrases in ordinary web writing, not in drug labels.
